oneSecondRead: This broad grounded object blocks a lane now, shows where it is weakening, and can be understood before the next enemy reaches it.
worldRole: A temporary, deliberately understandable interruption in the enemy route that turns path control into a visible player-authored hypothesis.
emotionalIntent: Dependable and brave without appearing invulnerable; its damage should create urgency and useful concern rather than helplessness.

orientation.front: A wide low fortress gate fragment: two planted feet, two outer posts, strong top and bottom rails, and three readable blocking bays facing the enemy.
orientation.playerSide: A complete, waist-height service socket or status module is readable from the safe rear side.
orientation.threatSide: Breaks, tilted panels and exposed structure progress from one localized weakness to a wide critical breach.

interactionZones.purpose: Communicate the load-bearing chassis that persists through damage.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Continuous thick frame and planted feet. Dark stable value mass. Color role: primary.

interactionZones.purpose: Show where enemies are physically stopped and where breaches form.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Three broad readable bays. Mid-value panels separated from frame. Color role: secondary.

interactionZones.purpose: Guide repair and status interaction from the safe side.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Complete socket when usable and open socket when disabled. Small high-contrast focal point. Color role: interaction.

interactionZones.purpose: Reveal the cause and progression of structural failure.
interactionZones.requiredCue: One major break then a widened breach with exposed load path. Bright exposed edge against dark frame. Color role: warning.

components.function: Transfer impact load to the ground and define the collision footprint.
Carry the barricade silhouette and preserve identity across all damage states.
Present the enemy-facing impact area and communicate localized structural damage.
Expose the player-facing repair and status interaction point.

movements: one attached panel hangs or shudders
the attached failed panel settles into a stable disabled posture

states.visualChange: A fully closed, planted and repair-ready barrier whose complete frame and panel rhythm promise temporary but credible protection. All three bays are closed and aligned. The service socket is complete and emits a calm ready signal.
invariants: Dimensions, footprint, pivot and front orientation remain fixed across territories and states.
The structural frame, two-foot grounding logic and three-bay rhythm remain recognizable.
The player interaction point remains on the safe rear side at the same gameplay anchor.
Damage never moves the collision footprint or invents detached gameplay-blocking fragments.
Component IDs and effect anchors remain stable across regeneration.

states.visualChange: One localized failure makes the barrier visibly weaker while the chassis, footprint and repair affordance remain unmistakably usable. One panel drops, opens or shifts along a plausible joint. One frame or bracket break exposes bare structure without creating a full passage.

states.visualChange: A wide causal breach and opened service system show imminent collapse while the same frame, feet and player ownership remain readable. collisionPromise: Keep the bottom_center pivot, footprint and gameplay anchors identical in every generated state.
obligations: Reconstruct every primary and secondary component defined by this canon.
Produce every required state from the same component structure and stable anchors.
Preserve the one-second function, front, interaction, danger and state readings.
Record this canon ID and exact SHA-256 in the compliance envelope.
constraints: Dimensions are 8.0 x 4.0 x 2.0 studs with tolerance 0.005.
Pivot is bottom_center and component anchors remain stable.
One UV set and one material slot maximum per production mesh component.
freedoms: edge_wear: 0 to 8 percent of exposed edge length. Adds bounded history without competing with state readability.
tertiary_fastener_choice: one approved fastener family per territory. Allows construction flavor while keeping every joint semantically plausible.
approved_asymmetry: territory target only. Expresses the territory without changing footprint, panel count or front-back reading.
prohibitions: a fourth blocking bay or missing bay
thin spikes, wires or floating armor plates
front-facing interaction cues that confuse the safe side
random cracks unrelated to a load path
logos, text, tally marks or unexplained ornament
microscopic underside details invisible in play
decorative repair with no causal reason
more than three visible material families
literal construction-toy motifs or pristine molded-plastic identity
